entries.notes: Configured-builder composition and manifest construction should stay below 100 us and under roughly 55 KB allocated in the shipped benchmark scenario.
Configured-builder composition under strict capability trust filtering should stay below 100 us and under roughly 55 KB allocated in the shipped benchmark scenario.
Configured-builder composition for the shipped phase-8 companion-pack baseline should stay below 250 us and under roughly 135 KB allocated in the benchmark scenario.
Prepared runtime initialize/start/stop lifecycle overhead should stay below 30 us and under roughly 15 KB allocated for the benchmark scenario.
Prepared runtime initialize/start/stop lifecycle overhead for the shipped phase-8 companion-pack baseline should stay below 100 us and under roughly 50 KB allocated in the benchmark scenario.

Correlated ASP.NET Core request logging with request/response body capture and default sensitive-value redaction should stay below 150 us and under roughly 40 KB allocated per request in the shipped benchmark scenario.
Correlated ASP.NET Core request logging with oversized textual payloads should stay below 170 us and under roughly 150 KB allocated per request while request and response capture are truncated.
Correlated ASP.NET Core request logging under the shipped 32-request concurrent batch should stay below 30 us of throughput-oriented per-request cost and under roughly 40 KB allocated per request.
Scaffolding should stay below 325 us and under roughly 575 KB allocated in the benchmark scenario.
Phase-8 scaffolding should stay below 375 us and under roughly 625 KB allocated while emitting the structured config, additive pack hints, and starter-test baseline.
